author: S_Kyle
notes_extra: No charge. He tried to run them faster and did not have much luck. He did not name the cartridge; the thread is 208 gr LRHT in F-TR.

author: D-4297
notes_extra: His 200.20x load, used for five 208s at 0.005 off in a 0.180 freebore chamber, at 600 yards in an 8 mph wind. No velocity. He did not name the cartridge; the thread is the 30 cal 208.

author: Down South
notes_extra: No charge. Jumping 0.009. Freebore about 250. He did not name the cartridge; Palma brass in the F-TR thread.

author: Crow
notes_extra: New-barrel break-in at 100 yards. 31.75 in 9.5-twist Bartlein, 0.250 freebore. No pressure signs. A Shotmarker extrapolation of 2725 fps for the 44.1 gr group was one he called suspicious, so it is not stored. He did not name the cartridge; the thread is F-TR.

author: Crow
notes_extra: Oehler 35P average. Groups between 44.2 and 44.4 caught his eye; 44.3 is the charge he averaged. He later said this speed did not hold small groups from 0.003 to 0.025 jump.

author: Crow
notes_extra: He backed off to this charge and ended at 0.025 jump. It about held 10-ring elevation at 500 yards.

author: Crow
notes_extra: About 0.024 jump. He identified this charge on Aug 24, 2023 as the load for the April 6, 2021 match targets, which he had described as running about 2575 fps.

author: rpierce
notes_extra: One range, 0.2 gr steps, ES 14 fps. Neck tension 0.003. He used graphite lube before seating. He did not name the cartridge or the powder. The post he answered said 300 wsm with 555. Barrel had not sped up yet.

author: rpierce
notes_extra: A second node from the same 208 test. He did not name the cartridge or the powder. The post he answered said 300 wsm with 555.

author: tclaunch
notes_extra: Sam Hall's 300 SAM case. He wrote Vihtavuori N555. Started at 55 gr and 0.006 jump, then 0.007 off. He shot one at a time until he hit 2850 fps; that speed is not stored as this charge's velocity. Three shots in one hole at 100 yards. Brux 1.250 in, 10 twist. No barrel length.

author: ronsatspokane
notes_extra: Berger 208s in a 300WSM a couple of years before this post. No velocity. He warned the load may be too much for another gun.

author: Willow
notes_extra: He also wrote H4831sc. Comfortable, no pressure signs. It shot with a 10 thou jam and a 10 thou jump. He answered a question about the 208 gr Berger Hybrid in a .300 WSM.
